content.short: ArbitrageScanner API provides an API for cryptocurrency services.
content.description: ArbitrageScanner API extends the platform's capabilities by giving developers programmatic access to its analytical and arbitrage tooling. With the API, you can build analytical services, automate arbitrage strategies, and integrate CEX and DEX data into your projects. Key features include wallet search and analysis, spread notifications for spot-to-spot and spot-to-futures, and a set of blockchain analytics tools that support custom workflows. Use cases include building dashboards, alerting systems, and data-driven arbitrage experiments across multiple chains.
